about_short_description.short_description: PetroApp is an NFC technology based fuel monitoring system for vehicles.

product.name: NFC Fuel Monitoring System
product.description: An electronic system that uses an NFC chip installed in vehicles to control and monitor fuel consumption, enabling automated fuel transactions and precise tracking.

product.name: Oil Change Service
product.description: A service that offers bulk oil changes for company vehicles, with electronic documentation to prevent tampering and reminders for periodic changes.

product.name: Vehicle Washing Service
product.description: A system to schedule and document vehicle washing, including archiving operations and photographing vehicles before and after washing.

product.name: Battery Supply Service
product.description: A service that supplies batteries to customers with electronic documentation to prevent fraud and ensure accurate tracking.

product.name: Fleet Management System
product.description: An advanced system with a control panel for tracking fleet vehicles, including weight sensors and integration with public transport and food and drug authorities.

product.name: QR Code Payment System
product.description: A system that generates a QR code for each vehicle to facilitate payments and track fuel and service consumption.
